upstream.description: A fast AI Video Generator for the GPU Poor. Supports Wan 2.1/2.2, LTX-2, Qwen Image, Hunyuan Video, LTX  Video and Flux.

classification.analysis: WanGP (Wan2GP) is a fast, actively developed all-in-one generative media app for GPU-constrained users, wrapping many open-source video (Wan, LTX-2, Hunyuan Video, LongCat), image (Qwen Image, Flux, HiDream), and audio/TTS (Ace Step, Qwen3 TTS, Chatterbox) models behind one web UI. It supports low-VRAM setups (as little as 6GB), older and AMD GPUs, LoRA customization, quantized checkpoints (int8/fp8/GGUF/NVFP4), a generation queue, headless batch mode, and an API for embedding generation into other apps. An extremely active project with frequent weekly releases and a large Discord community, aimed at hobbyists and builders who want broad open-source model coverage without high-end hardware.

use_cases.title: Generate AI video, image, or audio on a low-VRAM or older GPU
Run a queued batch of generation jobs headlessly
Add generative video/image/audio capability to your own app via API
Apply LoRAs across many open-source video and image models
